strings: With some level of despair m_c talks to r_c about the tremors and inconsistency of {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} hindlegs ever since the illness started.
It would appear that m_c's tick fever has led to the development of intermittent paralysis.
When m_c notices that {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} can't get up properly from the nest {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/panic/panics}.
